payload.label: SIMULATED PERSONALIZATION RESULT
limitations: Synthetic transition assumptions; not measured student learning.
Frozen content and noisy reasoning fixtures do not evaluate live generator/verifier/diagnosis quality.
Equal maximum horizon; policies may stop early. Held-out checks are common and never taught.
Template repetition groups manually declared equivalent structures; no semantic embedding threshold.
Confidence intervals condition on this simulator and five fixed profiles; no significance test.

policy_definitions.CONCEPTLENS: Production create_session, submit_probe, select_prerequisite, feedback, advance, prerequisite_choice and submit_attempt with frozen content and memory persistence
policy_definitions.FIXED: source_explanation -> worked_example -> transfer_check, irrespective of observations
policy_definitions.SIMPLE ADAPTIVE: wrong entry answer -> worked_example -> general_practice; otherwise source_explanation; then transfer_check; failed transfer repeats worked example and practice
